title: Akiyama Mizuki — Brand New Style〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Let's see... Oh, there!
I think it's that shop, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mhm... We finally made it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Finally? You hardly even walked from the station. You basically just clung to my back the entire time.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But I'm so sleepy...
*Yawn*

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I know you felt really inspired to draw, but this is what you get for pulling an all-nighter.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And you haven't covered up the bags under your eyes very well. Instead of Enanan, people might start calling you Pandanan♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What's with the name? Isn't that actually some kind of plant?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, good. They don't open for another thirty minutes, but there's hardly a line.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. We might be able to get in right when they open. I can't wait to try their apple pie. It's supposed to be “outta this world”.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And I think ice cream was the most popular topping.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, but I'm kinda looking forward to seeing how the actual apple pie tastes. I think I'll pass on any toppings.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, that's pretty rare of you considering how much you care about how these things look.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That doesn't mean I'm not allowed to.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Also, if it is as good as advertised, I'll need to tell Honami about this place.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah. She really loves apple pies, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But she does know about basically every store around Shibuya station.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: On second thought, if she likes checking out what different shops have to offer, then I don't think we need to tell her about...
Hey, Ena and Mizuki are here!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki & Ena
rows.Line:
Hm?
Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Emu! Honami!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hello. Are you two also here to get apple pies?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. We were actually just talking about you, Honami. This place is supposed to be really good, so I was gonna tell you about it later.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Then, right on cue, you showed us that you already knew about this shop♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I'd heard that a rival of this other apple pie shop started doing business here. I got curious and came to see what it was like.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, okay.
And I'm guessing Honami invited you to come along, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup☆ Apple pies mean a lot to us, and I've really been wanting to go out for some together again.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They mean a lot to you?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Before Emu and I became close friends, we actually bumped into each other at this other apple pie shop.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: One thing led to another, and we ended up having some together. After that, we began talking more and more.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: To us, apple pies are like Cupid's arrow if it were meant to make people friends♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Really? I had no idea!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Then, does this mean friendship Cupid's getting ready to shoot another arrow?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
That was so good!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: As advertised, it was outta this world.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I just couldn't stop eating mine until it was gone.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I saw the way you smiled after you took your first bite, Honami. Your eyes were all sparkly♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wait, you were watching?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I don't think I've ever seen anyone look so happy while having an apple pie!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
You two were also watching?!
I-I'm so embarrassed...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I think seeing you smile the way you did made us just as happy. It was infectious.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
And I'm so glad we got to talk so much!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm really glad we got to talk too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you for inviting us to join you, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. You're very welcome.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: By the way, what are you two doing after this? We're planning on doing a little shopping...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry.
We both have plans after this...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Aww, that's too bad!
Then, next time!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, and thank you both very much for today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Emu, I'll see you again at school.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! I know we're in different classes now, but I'm hoping we'll still see a lot of each other♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Should we also do that?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's not like we were ever in the same class...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean, we're still working together on stuff for N25, so we should try to keep doing what we have been instead of treating this like a new beginning, you know?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I see your point...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Then, Ena, let's both keep up the good work.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, okay. Let's.
